organizational_logic: Organizes disciplines into main classes, divisions, and sections, with decimal notation expressing successive subdivisions.
inclusion_basis: Existing research seed; provides a reference for general-purpose decimal hierarchical classification.
boundary_note: Different editions, language versions, and the WebDewey service are consolidated as one system.

organizational_logic: Branches into lettered main classes and subclasses, then subdivides subjects using number ranges in the classification schedules.
inclusion_basis: Existing research seed; provides a reference for alphanumeric classification schedules.
boundary_note: Classification Web is an access product and is not counted separately.

organizational_logic: Combines a decimal hierarchy with auxiliary symbols and combination rules to express multiple subject dimensions together.
inclusion_basis: Existing seed; preserves the structural distinction of synthetic classification compared with purely enumerative categories.
boundary_note: Language versions, summaries, and MRF versions are not counted separately.

organizational_logic: Classifies and indexes papers through hierarchical paths from broader to more specific subjects.
inclusion_basis: Adds an independent disciplinary classification directly related to the existing computing examples.
boundary_note: The official PDF's text is readable through search; direct retrieval previously returned 403. Editions are consolidated, and the search tool is not counted as an additional KOS.
source_title: How to Classify Works Using ACM’s Computing Classification System

resource_name: Australian and New Zealand Standard Research Classification
subject_domain: Research activities; disciplinary fields; R&D objectives
organizational_logic: The system comprises Type of Activity, Fields of Research, and Socio-Economic Objective; Fields of Research has three levels: division-group-field.
inclusion_basis: Adds an independently maintained regional R&D classification with correspondences to FORD.
boundary_note: ANZSRC is counted as one system this round; components and the 2008/2020 editions are not counted again.
source_title: Australian and New Zealand Standard Research Classification, 2020

resource_name: APA PsycInfo Classification Categories and Codes
organizational_logic: Classifies the main content of records using broad subject classes and subclassification codes.
inclusion_basis: Adds a psychology literature classification and clarifies the distinction between classifying database content and classifying the entire discipline.
boundary_note: Not conflated with the APA Thesaurus or PsycTests classification.
source_title: APA PsycInfo Classification Categories and Codes

organizational_logic: Groups instruments by the psychological subject they are intended to assess; the checked page is a list of parallel categories, and no parent-child tree is inferred.
inclusion_basis: Unlike PsycInfo's classification of literature by main subject, official documentation explicitly identifies this as a separate classification.
boundary_note: Included as a flat subject classification; numbers such as 5000 and 5100 are not mechanically interpreted as parent-child relations.

subject_domain: Physics; mathematics; computing; statistics; economics; etc.
organizational_logic: Organizes submission subjects by Group, Archive, and Category, with scope descriptions for categories; some cross-disciplinary categories use aliases.
inclusion_basis: Adds a subject scheme long used by a preprint platform, illustrating cross-disciplinary categories and scope notes.
boundary_note: Only the classification scheme is counted; aliases of the same category are not counted again.

subject_domain: Science; social sciences; arts and humanities; journals
organizational_logic: Classifies source journals by subject areas and subordinate categories; a journal may belong to several categories.
inclusion_basis: Adds a journal-level cross-disciplinary scheme identified through the review, distinguishing journal classification from paper-content classification.
boundary_note: Scopus is a database; only the ASJC scheme is counted, not the platform.
source_title: What are Scopus subject area categories and ASJC codes?

organizational_logic: Organizes active substances into five category levels by the organ acted upon and therapeutic/pharmacological/chemical properties.
inclusion_basis: Adds a hierarchical drug-domain classification, distinct from disease and health-intervention systems.
boundary_note: DDD is a statistical unit of dosage and is not treated as another KOS; annual ATC editions are consolidated.

organizational_logic: First organizes concepts into facets such as entities, properties, and processes, then combines them into compound classes according to citation order.
inclusion_basis: Adds an example of faceted classification distinct from decimal enumerative classification.
boundary_note: BC1 and BC2 are consolidated as one system lineage this round; the record primarily describes BC2. Directly opening the PDF may fail, but search can return the official original text.
source_title: Bliss Bibliographic Classification — Class C Chemistry preliminaries

organizational_logic: Decomposes subjects into facets and combines them in a prescribed order; compound classes are formed from basic concepts.
inclusion_basis: Adds an independent early system of systematic faceted classification; historical age is not used to assess quality.
boundary_note: Historical system; the current maintenance cycle was not verified this round. Editions are not counted separately.
source_title: Ranganathan — Method of Conjecture and Colon Classification

organizational_logic: Organizes chemical categories into an is_a tree according to molecular structure rules, including levels such as Kingdom, Superclass, Class, and Subclass.
inclusion_basis: The original paper provides explicit classification hierarchies, chemical class definitions, and computable structural rules.
secondary_attributes: F3: Classification ontology with computational rules
boundary_note: The ChemOnt category system is counted; ClassyFire is a classification service using that system and is not counted as another KOS.
source_title: ClassyFire: automated chemical classification with a comprehensive, computable taxonomy

subject_domain: General knowledge; Chinese-language books and literature
organizational_logic: Divides categories by discipline, representing main classes with letters and subdivisions with numbers.
inclusion_basis: Adds an independent general classification widely used in China.
related_resources: CLC editions and abridged schedules consolidated
boundary_note: The source introduction includes information on earlier editions; it is used only to confirm identity and structure, without claiming to establish the latest edition.
source_title: Introduction to the Chinese Library Classification

resource_name: Classification of the Functions of Government
organizational_logic: Divides expenditure into divisions, groups, and classes according to the government functions or socioeconomic objectives it is intended to achieve.
inclusion_basis: Adds a classification organizing government expenditure objects by the purpose of the activity.
boundary_note: Revision is in progress; editions are not listed separately.
source_title: Classification of the Functions of Government

resource_name: Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose
organizational_logic: Organizes divisions, groups, classes, and subclasses by consumption purpose, distinguishing more specific consumption objects.
inclusion_basis: Adds economic statistical categories divided by use rather than production process.
boundary_note: Statistical extension candidate; not a general library subject classification. Revisions are consolidated.

organizational_logic: A hierarchical classification comprising patent technology categories, classification definitions, and application rules, with correspondences to IPC.
inclusion_basis: Although it inherits from and maps to IPC, it remains an independently maintained patent classification.
boundary_note: CPC-Patent distinguishes it from the United Nations Central Product Classification; releases are consolidated.
source_title: Cooperative Patent Classification — Frequently asked questions

subtype: Domain-specific statistical classification / Goods and services
organizational_logic: Organizes products through goods and services categories and detailed explanations, with correspondences to economic activity and trade classifications.
inclusion_basis: Adds the United Nations product statistical classification, distinguishing it from the patent classification with the same abbreviation.
boundary_note: CPC-Product distinguishes it from CPC-Patent; editions are consolidated. The UNSD catalog also lists Ver.3.0 materials.

organizational_logic: The main vocabulary organizes procurement subjects in a code tree; the supplementary vocabulary adds qualitative information.
inclusion_basis: Although named a vocabulary, official documentation explicitly identifies it as a procurement classification system; assigned primarily to F1 according to its principal use.
boundary_note: The main and supplementary vocabularies are treated as one system this round and are not counted separately.

organizational_logic: Uses research topics as nodes, superTopicOf for broader/narrower topic relations, and relatedEquivalent for approximately equivalent topics; automatically generated from a paper corpus and partly revised by experts.
inclusion_basis: The official portal and original paper explicitly provide a reusable, fine-grained research topic network.
boundary_note: Its primary assignment to F1 reflects its topic classification structure; OWL format alone does not make it a strongly axiomatized ontology. Versions are consolidated.

resource_name: DFG Classification of Scientific Disciplines, Research Areas, Review Boards and Subject Areas
organizational_logic: Organizes funding fields by scientific discipline, research area, review board, and specific subject area.
inclusion_basis: Adds a system for research funding and review management, distinguished from literature shelving.
boundary_note: Election-cycle versions are not counted separately; unknown relations are not inferred from code strings.
source_title: DFG Classification of Scientific Disciplines, Research Areas, Review Boards and Subject Areas (2024–2028)

organizational_logic: Describes products using properties, values, units, and other elements beneath four product-category levels; advanced structures may include application classes and blocks.
inclusion_basis: Adds product knowledge organization combining a class hierarchy with structured properties.
boundary_note: BASIC and ADVANCED are content levels of the same standard and are not counted separately this round.

subject_domain: Life sciences; physical sciences and engineering; social sciences and humanities
organizational_logic: First divides research into three broad domains, then review Panels, each with a name and scope description.
inclusion_basis: Adds a research field system divided according to review responsibilities.
boundary_note: Annual Panel structures are consolidated; the internal detailed MFR scheme is not counted additionally.
source_title: ERC Work Programme — Primary Panel Structure

subject_domain: EU research projects; scientific fields; emerging topics
organizational_logic: Aligns upper levels with OECD/FORD and extends lower levels with fields and specific topics from project texts to form a hierarchical classification.
inclusion_basis: Official documentation explicitly specifies a research-field hierarchy with independent extension and maintenance, so it is primarily classified as a classification system, with controlled vocabulary features also noted.
boundary_note: Distinct from EuroVoc; CORDIS is an application platform and is not counted as a separate classification. The review's label European Commission taxonomy is broad; this entry uses only the name of the specific verified resource.

resource_name: Fields of Research and Development Classification
subject_domain: Natural sciences; engineering; medicine; agriculture; social sciences; humanities
organizational_logic: Groups research into broader one-digit and narrower two-digit fields according to similarity of research content.
inclusion_basis: Adds a cross-disciplinary field structure for R&D statistics.
boundary_note: The classification resource within the manual is included; the entire statistical methodology manual is not treated as a KOS.

organizational_logic: Segment-Family-Class-Brick form product categories; Brick attributes and values supply additional product details.
inclusion_basis: Adds a global trade product classification, distinguished from barcodes identifying individual products.
related_resources: ECLASS; UNSPSC; GTIN (identifier, not a candidate)
boundary_note: GTIN is a product identification standard, not another subject classification; GPC editions are consolidated.

resource_name: Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System
organizational_logic: Classifies progressively from chapters to headings and subheadings; the international portion uses six-digit codes governed by classification rules.
inclusion_basis: Adds a hierarchical system for commodity classification, distinct from industry, expenditure, and literature classifications.
boundary_note: National eight-digit or ten-digit tariff extensions are not counted separately this round; annual editions are consolidated.

resource_name: International Statistical Classification of Diseases and Related Health Problems
organizational_logic: Forms a classification hierarchy for diseases and health problems; ICD-11 requires distinguishing the Foundation's semantic structure from linearizations such as MMS.
inclusion_basis: Adds a medical statistical classification illustrating the distinction between clinical concept organization and statistical coding.
secondary_attributes: ICD-11 Foundation has ontology / Semantic network features
boundary_note: ICD-10, ICD-11, and national modifications belong to the same lineage; Foundation, MMS, and browsers are not counted separately.

resource_name: International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health
subject_domain: Body functions; activities and participation; environmental factors
organizational_logic: Organizes functioning by health and health-related domains and incorporates environmental factors.
inclusion_basis: Complements disease diagnosis classification by organizing domains related to functioning and disability.
boundary_note: ICF-CY has been merged back into ICF and is therefore not counted separately.
source_title: International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF)

subject_domain: Diagnosis and treatment; nursing; rehabilitation; public health interventions
organizational_logic: Organizes interventions along three axes: Target, Action, and Means; extension codes provide further detail.
inclusion_basis: Organizes interventions rather than diseases or functioning, so it is included separately from ICD and ICF.
boundary_note: Not all code segments should be interpreted as parent-child relations in a single tree; categories within axes must be distinguished from combination relations.

organizational_logic: Progressively extends alphanumeric notation to represent more specific image subjects, accompanied by textual definitions and auxiliary rules.
inclusion_basis: Adds a subject classification for non-textual documents, covering images in art.
boundary_note: Classifies image subjects, not image file formats or lists of individual artists.

subject_domain: General practice; primary care encounters; symptoms; functioning
organizational_logic: Organizes clinical categories by body system and information types such as encounters, symptoms and diseases, interventions, and functioning.
inclusion_basis: Adds a system specifically designed to organize concepts in primary care records.
boundary_note: ICPC-2 and ICPC-3 are consolidated as one system; chapter changes should be retained as version differences.

subject_domain: Technical standards; industry; management; multiple disciplines
organizational_logic: A three-level structure of fields-groups-subgroups, expressed progressively through two-digit field numbers, three-digit group numbers, and two-digit subgroup numbers.
inclusion_basis: Adds a cross-domain subject classification for technical standards documents.
boundary_note: ICS is the classification schedule; ISO itself and its standards catalog platform are not counted separately.

organizational_logic: Section-class-subclass-main group-subgroup; subgroup hierarchy is determined by dot indentation before titles and cannot be inferred solely from code length.
inclusion_basis: Adds an international classification organizing patents by technical subject.
boundary_note: Revisions from different years and language versions are consolidated.
source_title: International Patent Classification: Frequently Asked Questions

resource_name: International Standard Classification of Education / Fields of Education and Training
subject_domain: Education levels; educational programs; fields of study
organizational_logic: Groups educational programs and qualifications by education level or field of study; the fields component complements the main ISCED framework.
inclusion_basis: Adds a standard classification covering multidisciplinary fields of study, while noting its statistical purpose.
boundary_note: ISCED and ISCED-F are consolidated within one framework this round; language versions and editions are not counted repeatedly.
source_title: International Standard Classification of Education — ISCED

organizational_logic: Progressively groups jobs into unit groups, minor groups, sub-major groups, and major groups according to similarities in skill level and skill specialization.
inclusion_basis: Adds a classification organized around occupational skills and job tasks.
boundary_note: ISCO editions and national implementations are not counted repeatedly.
source_title: The International Standard Classification of Occupations — ISCO-08

resource_name: International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities
organizational_logic: Divides activities into sections, divisions, groups, and classes based on similarity of production activities.
inclusion_basis: Included in the expanded scope as a structured domain classification, with its purpose of classifying statistical units explicitly noted.
boundary_note: This description uses Rev.4 as an example; UNSD also lists Rev.5 materials, so the older page is not used to claim that Rev.4 is the latest.
source_title: International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities (ISIC)

organizational_logic: Organizes literature into broad economics classes, secondary subjects, and detailed topics, with classification application guidance.
inclusion_basis: Adds a disciplinary literature classification from the social sciences.
related_resources: EconLit Subject Descriptors (a presentation of the same system)
boundary_note: JEL and its EconLit presentation format are consolidated and not counted repeatedly.

subject_domain: Societal grand challenges, key enabling technologies, research policy
organizational_logic: Topic classes combine lexical instances and keywords to connect user queries, publications, projects, and patents; the class hierarchy supports research and policy topic classification.
inclusion_basis: The official project publishes its topic system, versions, and documentation for ontology-based classification.
secondary_attributes: F3: Topic application ontology; F2: Topic vocabulary
boundary_note: Primarily assigned to F1; KNOWMAK and RISIS-KNOWMAK versions are consolidated; not conflated with the unrelated KNOW Ontology.

organizational_logic: Classes, subclasses, and an alphabetical list of goods jointly organize the goods used in design registration.
inclusion_basis: Adds a classification of design objects, distinct from patented invention technologies.
boundary_note: EPIC is an additional hierarchical tool based on LOC; official documentation states that it is not part of the formal LOC text. It is not counted separately this round.

resource_name: Microsoft Academic Graph Fields of Study
organizational_logic: The top two levels are manually curated, while finer levels use models to generate broader/narrower relations; some isolated topics lack reliable parent-child links.
inclusion_basis: Adds a semiautomated classification lineage and historical resource, explicitly avoiding forcing every topic into a complete tree.
secondary_attributes: F4 Topic component of a knowledge graph
boundary_note: A subsequent official announcement confirms that the service ended in late 2021; this entry is a historical classification and does not assume current data can be obtained from the original interface.
source_title: Expanding Concept Understanding in Microsoft Academic Graph

organizational_logic: Organizes mathematical research topics using two-, three-, and five-character categories.
inclusion_basis: Adds a disciplinary literature classification covering mathematics.
related_resources: The SKOS representation of MSC is not counted separately
boundary_note: Versions such as MSC2010 and MSC2020 are consolidated.

resource_name: Statistical Classification of Economic Activities in the European Union
organizational_logic: Organizes statistical units by economic activity categories and delimits categories using inclusion, additional inclusion, and exclusion notes.
inclusion_basis: Adds an independently maintained EU classification with correspondences to ISIC.
boundary_note: National NACE-derived schedules are not expanded separately this round; NACE versions are consolidated.

organizational_logic: Classifies establishments by similarity of production processes, progressively subdividing into sectors, subsectors, industry groups, industries, and national industries.
inclusion_basis: Adds a regional industry classification related to ISIC but independently developed and maintained.
boundary_note: The three national implementations and annual editions are counted as one system.
source_title: Economic Census: NAICS Codes & Understanding Industry Classification Systems

subject_domain: Life sciences; physical sciences; health and related fields
organizational_logic: Subject pages organize content through broader/narrower relations, allowing navigation from broad fields to specific subjects.
inclusion_basis: Adds a subject navigation system actively used by a publisher.
secondary_attributes: F2 Controlled subject vocabulary features with broader/narrower relations
boundary_note: The object of study is the sitewide subject scheme; pages displaying the same subject in different journals are not counted repeatedly. Homepage retrieval failed because of a redirect, but official subject-page text is verifiable through search.

organizational_logic: Progressively subdivides ten main classes, adding digits to express more specific subjects.
inclusion_basis: A general classification independently compiled and maintained in Japan; not treated as a translation of DDC.
related_resources: DDC (historical relationship, not a language mirror)
boundary_note: Revised and simplified editions are consolidated.

subtype: Intellectual property / Trademark goods and services classification
organizational_logic: Organizes the objects covered by trademarks through goods and services classes and entries.
inclusion_basis: Adds a classification of trademark goods and services, explicitly distinguishing its objects from figurative elements of marks.
boundary_note: Goods-name search tools and term lists accepted by national trademark offices are not counted again as new systems.
source_title: Select Your Trademark Goods and Services

subject_domain: Medicine; basic medical sciences; medical literature
organizational_logic: Organizes library materials using schedules for medicine and related sciences; its role differs from that of the MeSH subject vocabulary.
inclusion_basis: Adds a specialized library classification, distinguishing medical literature shelving from clinical disease coding.
boundary_note: Not consolidated with MeSH; the two are related but differ in resource identity and purpose.

subject_domain: Science; social sciences; arts and humanities
organizational_logic: Four levels: Domain-Field-Subfield-Topic; detailed topics map to ASJC-derived subfields, and papers are assigned topics by a content model.
inclusion_basis: Adds a data-driven topic hierarchy and distinguishes it from the journal classification it reuses.
counting_unit: Classification attached to a graph or platform
boundary_note: Only the disciplinary topic scheme is counted; OpenAlex's author, institution, and paper graph is not additionally counted in this entry. The old Concepts are not listed again as an active scheme.

organizational_logic: Divides physics, astronomy, and related subjects into hierarchical categories identified by codes.
inclusion_basis: Retains a formerly widespread historical classification to document the transition from one classification system to a new one.
boundary_note: Historical / No longer maintained; not described as an active candidate. Editions are consolidated.

organizational_logic: A five-level subject structure; multiple parents are possible, but one primary parent is designated, and papers may receive multiple classifications.
inclusion_basis: Adds a philosophy classification traced through the research-field KOS review, covering a multiple-parent structure in the humanities.
boundary_note: Distinguishes the website's classification scheme from its paper index database; MindPapers is consolidated as a historical source this round.

organizational_logic: Organizes concepts into facets such as research areas and physical systems; each facet has broader/narrower hierarchies, supplemented by related relations and disciplinary groupings.
inclusion_basis: Adds a faceted disciplinary classification that can span branches, distinct from PACS's code hierarchy.
secondary_attributes: Controlled subject vocabulary / Faceted classification features
boundary_note: Although its name includes Subject Headings, official documentation positions it as a faceted classification; primarily assigned to F1.

organizational_logic: Organizes collections through multiple disciplinary classification branches for shelving and cooperative subject indexing.
inclusion_basis: Adds an independently maintained academic library classification from German-speaking regions.
boundary_note: RVK-Online is an online service for the same classification.

subject_domain: Science and technology; social sciences; arts and humanities
organizational_logic: Organized into three levels: Domain-Field-Subfield; journal- and article-level versions share the classification framework.
inclusion_basis: Adds an independent scheme for disciplinary bibliometrics and records its reuse of existing journal classifications as sources.
boundary_note: Journal-level, article-level, and hybrid classification approaches are not counted separately; the webpage failed to open directly, but the official text is verifiable through search.

subtype: Cross-disciplinary topic classification extended through reuse
subject_domain: Multidisciplinary research fields; emerging research topics
organizational_logic: Uses OECD/FORD for the top two levels, connects Science-Metrix at the third, and extends finer levels using citation clustering and topic modeling.
inclusion_basis: The original paper and author repository explicitly show independently extended levels, beyond merely renaming FORD on a platform.
counting_unit: Classification attached to a graph or platform
boundary_note: The current OpenAIRE API mainly exposes coarse OECD levels; no claim is made that its active interface fully exposes all six levels. The classification scheme, classification algorithm, and OpenAIRE Graph are distinguished.

organizational_logic: Organizes traded commodities into five hierarchical levels for aggregating trade statistics.
inclusion_basis: Adds a commodity classification for trade statistics; its purpose and structure differ from the customs HS.
boundary_note: Documentation from an official user institution; the UNSD catalog also verifies the system. Versions are consolidated.

organizational_logic: Imports classes from several existing ontologies and controlled vocabularies to form the disciplinary hierarchy needed by FAIRsharing, retaining definitions and appropriate synonyms.
inclusion_basis: The official repository explicitly identifies an independent application hierarchy for disciplinary annotation.
secondary_attributes: F3: OWL application ontology; F2: Controlled vocabulary reuse
related_resources: re3data; NCIt; EDAM; AGROVOC; OMIT; OBI; PO; UAT; DRAO
boundary_note: Primarily assigned to F1; all classes primarily reuse external resources, so the total class count cannot be treated as a count of original concepts. DRAO is a related domain-description application ontology, not an SRAO version.

resource_name: UNESCO Nomenclature for Fields of Science and Technology
subject_domain: Science and technology; research projects; theses and dissertations
organizational_logic: Three levels of field-discipline-subdiscipline, using two-, four-, and six-digit codes respectively.
inclusion_basis: Adds a research field classification distinct from the UNESCO Thesaurus; explicitly identifies the evidence as an institutional specialist catalog.
boundary_note: The original UNESCO page opened with an empty body; continued updating was not confirmed this round, and the original 1988 schedule is not called the current latest version. SKOS conversions are not counted separately.

resource_name: United Nations Standard Products and Services Code
organizational_logic: Organizes procurement objects through hierarchical product and service categories; the common core is Segment, Family, Class, and Commodity.
inclusion_basis: Adds a cross-industry procurement category system, illustrating an organizational purpose beyond industry classification.
boundary_note: UNDP describes five levels including an additional level; the U.S. Department of Commerce describes a four-level core. This discrepancy is retained, and the specific version should be checked before subsequent use.
source_title: United Nations Standard Products and Services Code

resource_name: U.S. Geological Survey Library Classification System
subject_domain: Earth sciences; geology; related natural sciences
organizational_logic: Subject, geographic, journal, map, and other schedules jointly form the structure for call numbers and subject retrieval.
inclusion_basis: Traces the official original report from the review to add comprehensive subject and geographic organization for specialized collections.
boundary_note: The systems described in the 1990 and 2000 reports are consolidated; PDF access failed, so only official report abstracts and metadata were checked.
source_title: U.S. Geological Survey Library classification system

resource_name: International Classification of the Figurative Elements of Marks
organizational_logic: Classifies the figurative elements of marks from general to specific through categories, divisions, and sections.
inclusion_basis: Adds an independent classification for structured organization of figurative elements.
boundary_note: Editions are consolidated; its objects differ from those of Nice, so the two are included separately.
source_title: Vienna Agreement Establishing an International Classification of the Figurative Elements of Marks

subject_domain: Science; social sciences; arts and humanities
organizational_logic: Labels source publications using controlled subject categories; a publication may have multiple categories. The current source page provides no parent-child tree.
inclusion_basis: Adds a widely used source-level bibliometric subject classification while preserving its flat nature.
secondary_attributes: F2 Flat controlled subject vocabulary features
boundary_note: Containment relations among identically named terms must not automatically be turned into an official hierarchy; the WoS database is not the counting object of this entry.

organizational_logic: Splits subject descriptions into separate facets to simplify LCSH's complex syntax.
inclusion_basis: Existing system; different ways of organizing vocabulary from the same source have comparative value.
boundary_note: Multiple facets count as one system; derived from LCSH, it cannot be treated as a fully independent corpus.

organizational_logic: Authorized subject headings express document content and organize subject retrieval through a controlled vocabulary.
inclusion_basis: Existing system; retains subject-heading organization as a comparative baseline.
boundary_note: Distinct from LCC, which is based on classification numbers.

organizational_logic: Organizes general concepts through multiple-parent hierarchies and associative relations, distinct from specific person and place entities.
inclusion_basis: Adds a polyhierarchical controlled vocabulary in the cultural heritage domain.
boundary_note: Only the concept-based AAT is placed in F2; Getty's entity authority resources have their primary groups noted separately.

organizational_logic: Represents concepts with multilingual labels and organizes agriculture-related terms as a SKOS concept scheme.
inclusion_basis: Adds controlled vocabulary for international agriculture and food.
boundary_note: ASFA is its subscheme; this catalog does not count ASFA again in the total.

organizational_logic: Authorized index terms have scope notes, hierarchies, and related terms to support subject retrieval.
inclusion_basis: Adds a psychology system with an explicit description of its organization.
boundary_note: APA databases and dictionaries are not the KOS counted in this entry.

organizational_logic: Descriptors, species names, geographical terms, etc. organize indexing; broader terms support broader searches.
inclusion_basis: Adds a specialized indexing system for agriculture and applied life sciences.
boundary_note: The names CAB and CABI are merged; bibliographic databases are not counted separately.
source_title: CABI’s controlled vocabulary and CABI Thesaurus

organizational_logic: Organizes nursing search subjects using the MeSH hierarchy and indexes literature with authorized concepts.
inclusion_basis: Adds verifiable structured vocabularies discovered through searching, broadening domain and language coverage.
boundary_note: The vocabulary is distinguished from the CINAHL bibliographic database; database product versions are not counted repeatedly.

organizational_logic: Follows LCSH heading principles, adds Canadian concepts, and includes broader/narrower and related references.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
boundary_note: An independently supplemented resource for a local context; not a wholly independent organizational paradigm.

organizational_logic: Preferred concepts include broader/narrower and related relationships; nonpreferred entry terms help unify retrieval.
inclusion_basis: Adds cross-national and multilingual organization of social science subjects.
boundary_note: Versions and labels in different languages are merged into one candidate.
source_title: The ELSST Thesaurus has been updated

organizational_logic: Biomedical terms are organized in a multibranch tree structure, supporting search expansion to narrower subjects.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
boundary_note: Has a content-source relationship with MeSH; the Embase literature database is not treated as a KOS.
source_title: What is Emtree and how do I use it?

organizational_logic: Educational subjects are indexed using authorized descriptors; broader/narrower and related relationships support retrieval.
inclusion_basis: Adds a literature subject system for education.
boundary_note: The ERIC literature database itself is not another KOS.
source_title: How Are ERIC Thesaurus Descriptors Assigned?

organizational_logic: A multilingual concept system covering EU activity subjects, used for subject indexing.
inclusion_basis: Adds policy and cross-language subject organization.
boundary_note: Different languages and release versions are merged into one entry.

organizational_logic: Earth science keywords are organized in multiple levels by discipline, topic, and variable, with additional facets such as location and instrument.
inclusion_basis: Adds hierarchical keyword organization for scientific data discovery.
boundary_note: Multiple keyword groups count as one system; uncontrolled detailed-variable fields are not treated as authorized nodes.

organizational_logic: Concepts are organized by generic relationships and themes/groups, with definitions, labels, and external mappings.
inclusion_basis: Adds a shared terminology system for environmental information retrieval.
boundary_note: Developed by integrating existing environmental vocabularies; not an independent substitute sample for every original source vocabulary.

subject_domain: Gender; sexual orientation; society and culture
organizational_logic: Connects LGBTQ+ concepts hierarchically as a supplementary vocabulary for general subject headings.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
boundary_note: Direct page access is restricted; verification this round used text visible in official search results. Versions are not counted repeatedly.

organizational_logic: Concepts are grouped by labour, employment, and related socioeconomic subjects, with multilingual labels.
inclusion_basis: Adds the labour and social policy domain.
boundary_note: Subject groups within the same scheme are not counted separately.

organizational_logic: Controlled descriptors and nonpreferred terms support input and retrieval of nuclear science and energy literature.
inclusion_basis: Adds a subject vocabulary jointly maintained over the long term in the energy domain.
boundary_note: The INIS and ETDE joint thesaurus is merged into one entry; the nuclear knowledge portal is not counted as a KOS.

organizational_logic: Controlled scientific concepts are connected through broader, narrower, and related relationships.
inclusion_basis: Adds a controlled indexing system for physics and engineering.
boundary_note: Separate from the Inspec classification code system; they serve the same database but have different organizational units.

resource_name: Library of Congress Demographic Group Terms
organizational_logic: Organizes entries using authorized group names and broader/narrower, related, and other relationships.
inclusion_basis: Adds specialized controlled vocabulary for describing population groups.
boundary_note: Group category codes are only grouping tools within this system and are not counted as a separate KOS.
source_title: Library of Congress Demographic Group Terms PDF Files

organizational_logic: Describes a resource's genre or form rather than the subject it discusses.
inclusion_basis: Adds genre and form dimensions of organization beyond subject headings.
boundary_note: Functionally distinct from LCSH and counted as an independent candidate; do not treat genre/form as a subject parent-child relationship.

resource_name: Library of Congress Medium of Performance Thesaurus for Music
organizational_logic: Uses controlled terms to describe the instruments, voices, and performance media required for a musical performance.
inclusion_basis: Adds a structured descriptive dimension for music.
boundary_note: Not equivalent to musical genre; individual instrument lists are not counted as independent systems.

resource_name: Llista d'encapçalaments de matèria en català
organizational_logic: Subject records include preferred headings, USE/UF terms, broader/narrower terms, and sources.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
boundary_note: Has local maintenance and addition procedures; not merely a language-display version.

organizational_logic: Concepts are represented by preferred/alternative labels, organized by broader-to-narrower relationships, and accompanied by scope notes.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
boundary_note: CRM alignment does not mean that the thesaurus itself is the CRM ontology.

resource_name: Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes
organizational_logic: Observation concepts are defined along multiple axes; Parts support concept composition and hierarchical grouping.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
boundary_note: Codes do not directly encode parent-child semantics; Parts/CHBS are internal organization and cannot be counted as independent terminology systems.

organizational_logic: Medical concepts are organized by tree positions; term and concept records are used for subject indexing of literature.
inclusion_basis: An existing, widely used medical subject heading system that adds domain-specific coverage.
boundary_note: The same concept can have multiple tree positions; annual editions are not counted repeatedly.

resource_name: National Agricultural Library Thesaurus Concept Space
organizational_logic: Agricultural concepts are organized by domain and type; the Concept Space includes subschemes such as Core and Full.
inclusion_basis: Adds a specialized agricultural vocabulary and a multischeme organizational form.
boundary_note: Core, Full, AWIC, and Taxon are grouped under one entry without increasing the candidate count repeatedly.
source_title: National Agricultural Library Thesaurus Concept Space

subject_domain: Aeronautics and astronautics; physics; space sciences
organizational_logic: Authorized subject terms include expanded hierarchies, definitions, USE references, and related terms.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
boundary_note: The two PDF volumes and representations such as SKOS/OWL are the same resource; historical releases are not claimed to contain the latest content.

organizational_logic: Controlled subject headings provide access points for retrieving literature by subject.
inclusion_basis: Adds a Japanese national library subject system.
boundary_note: Web NDL Authorities is a publishing service and is not counted as a separate system.
source_title: Classification, Subject Headings and Genre/Form Terms

resource_name: Ngā Upoko Tukutuku / Māori Subject Headings
organizational_logic: Preferred concepts are defined in Maori and English, with broader/narrower and related relationships and dialect entry terms.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
boundary_note: Not simply a Maori translation of LCSH.

organizational_logic: The subject indexing system comprises a thesaurus, application manual, combination rules, and other components.
inclusion_basis: Adds an Italian national subject indexing method.
boundary_note: The manual, online thesaurus, and export files are components of the same system.

organizational_logic: Parameters are expressed as authorized concepts, linked to constituent concepts, broader discovery categories, units, etc.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
boundary_note: P01 is a specific vocabulary; the NERC Vocabulary Server is its hosting platform and is not counted as another KOS.
source_title: BODC Parameter Dictionary for marine data

organizational_logic: Bilingual subject terms form a hierarchy from semantically general to specific, with associative and equivalence relationships.
inclusion_basis: Adds verifiable structured vocabularies discovered through searching, broadening domain and language coverage.
boundary_note: A hierarchical subject heading list; assigned to F2 based on its primary purpose.

resource_name: Répertoire d’autorité-matière encyclopédique et alphabétique unifié
organizational_logic: Controlled terms have generic, specific, and related relationships; precoordinate syntax constructs subject headings.
inclusion_basis: Adds an independently maintained French precoordinate subject language.
boundary_note: Although derived in part from RVM/LCSH, official documentation explicitly states its independent development; not merely a translated language version.

resource_name: RBMS Controlled Vocabulary for Rare Materials Cataloging
organizational_logic: Organizes characteristics of rare materials using authorized terms; includes nodes used only for hierarchical grouping, not direct indexing.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
boundary_note: The six earlier vocabularies have been integrated and are not counted again. Relationship Designators is a separately maintained companion resource, recorded in the boundary table this round.

organizational_logic: Combines controlled terms and specialized syntax to express concepts and document subjects.
inclusion_basis: Adds an independently maintained Canadian French subject heading system.
boundary_note: This entry uses the RVM subject system as its unit; associated derivative products are not counted individually.

organizational_logic: Synonymous drug names are grouped into concepts; standardized names comprise ingredients, strengths, dosage forms, brands, etc.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
boundary_note: Primarily standardizes terminology; not equivalent to a disease classification.

organizational_logic: Provides core subject headings, patterns, and examples for creating additional headings.
inclusion_basis: Adds subject headings for small and medium-sized libraries.
boundary_note: Different editions are merged; bulk-download availability is not assumed.

organizational_logic: Organizes economic concepts using authorized subject terms and entry terms, divided into several subthesauri.
inclusion_basis: Adds a specialized retrieval system for economics.
boundary_note: Subthesauri are not counted separately.

organizational_logic: Subject and genre/form terms are connected through broader/narrower, related, and USE/UF relationships for image indexing.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
boundary_note: The former TGM I/II have been merged and are counted together as TGM.

organizational_logic: Organizes literature indexing with social science subject terms and relationship structures; has a SKOS representation.
inclusion_basis: Adds a case of social science indexing vocabulary and cross-vocabulary connections.
boundary_note: The SKOS-converted version is not counted as a separate system.
source_title: TheSoz: A SKOS Representation of the Thesaurus for the Social Sciences

organizational_logic: Authorized terms form broader/narrower hierarchies beneath top-level concepts, with synonymous entry terms and related relationships.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
boundary_note: No additional notes

resource_name: Unified Medical Language System — Metathesaurus and Semantic Network
organizational_logic: Integrates synonymous concepts and source relationships from different vocabularies; the Semantic Network provides concept types and relationships between types.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
secondary_attributes: F3: Semantic types; F4: Concept relationship network
related_resources: MeSH; LOINC; RxNorm; SNOMED CT; ICD
boundary_note: This is an aggregation/mapping system, not counted as an independent source corpus for comparison; its components are merged into one entry.

organizational_logic: Concepts are organized by broad subjects and microthesauri for document subject analysis and retrieval.
inclusion_basis: Adds an international multidisciplinary and multilingual indexing system.
boundary_note: Language versions, microthesauri, and different serialization formats are merged.

organizational_logic: Scientific concepts are organized through parent-child and broader/narrower relationships for information discovery.
inclusion_basis: Adds verifiable structured vocabularies discovered through searching, broadening domain and language coverage.
boundary_note: A different organizational tool from the USGS Library Classification.

organizational_logic: Builds concept hierarchies using parent-child relationships, with additional associative and part-whole relationships and thematic groups.
inclusion_basis: Adds a case of transition from subject headings toward ontology-based organization.
boundary_note: Officially called an ontology; this study assigns it to F2 based on its primary purpose and explicitly notes its overlapping attributes. YSA/Allärs are recorded as sources. OWL/SKOS type tags alone do not demonstrate formal reasoning capability.

organizational_logic: Links classification numbers and subject terms into an integrated classification and subject indexing and retrieval system.
inclusion_basis: Public institutional documentation clearly identifies the resource and its organizational structure, adding a domain or organizational approach to this group.
boundary_note: Depends on CLC; Web/CD-ROM/print versions are not counted repeatedly.
source_title: Description of the Web Edition of the Chinese Classified Thesaurus

organizational_logic: Classes, instances, properties, and formal logical axioms; domain ontologies extend upper-level concepts.
inclusion_basis: Defines concepts and relationships in SUO-KIF and provides mappings to word-sense resources.
boundary_note: Domain modules are treated as the same system rather than counted individually.

organizational_logic: Agronomic practices, techniques, and experimental variables are organized through ontology terms and relationships.
inclusion_basis: An independent concept system for agronomic experiments, with a different focus from agricultural subject thesauri.
boundary_note: AGRO and AGROVOC are different systems and are not merged.

subject_domain: Biological samples, specimens, sampling, ecological observations
organizational_logic: Organizes concepts including biological samples, sampling and preservation processes, and ecological observations without physical sampling.
inclusion_basis: The original paper found while tracing PCO sources directly introduces the independent BCO, adding biodiversity sampling objects.
related_resources: ENVO; PCO; Darwin Core; OBO Foundry
boundary_note: Separate from PCO's populations and communities and ENVO's environmental entities; current maintenance frequency was not specifically checked.
source_title: Semantics in support of biodiversity knowledge discovery: an introduction to the biological collections ontology and related ontologies

organizational_logic: Provides a common framework for domain ontologies using upper-level categories and formal relationships.
inclusion_basis: Has an independent upper-level concept structure, providing a common semantic foundation for various domain ontologies.
boundary_note: BFO's OWL and OBO formats are not counted separately.

organizational_logic: A Linked Data model of bibliographic entities and relationships, distinguishing works, instances, and items.
inclusion_basis: Provides a semantic model of bibliographic concepts and entity relationships, distinct from subject classification schedules.
boundary_note: MARC conversion programs, editors, and different representation formats are not treated as additional KOS.

organizational_logic: Organizes bibliographic entities through inheritance among classes such as Document, Article, and AcademicArticle and through citation relationships.
inclusion_basis: The related-work section of the original SPAR paper points to this system; DCMI officially preserves its class and relationship specifications.
boundary_note: DCMI assumed responsibility for preservation and maintenance in 2018; not another name for Dublin Core metadata fields.

organizational_logic: Describes spatial organization through core building topology concepts and their relationships.
inclusion_basis: Has an independent concept structure for building topology, with a different focus from the equipment-centered Brick.
boundary_note: In the same building domain but not a version or format of Brick; an independent candidate.

organizational_logic: Classes and relationships connect physical, logical, and virtual building assets and system components.
inclusion_basis: Provides structured descriptions of building assets and relationships, with an independent ontology and maintenance community.
boundary_note: Brick release packages may include RealEstateCore; file counts are not used to count systems repeatedly.
source_title: Brick: A Uniform Metadata Schema for Buildings

subject_domain: Cross-domain objects such as entities, events, agents, information, and measurements
organizational_logic: Uses BFO as its upper ontology, with multiple interoperating mid-level ontologies providing extensible common classes and relationships.
inclusion_basis: The original paper defines CCO as a mid-level system bridging foundational and domain ontologies.
boundary_note: Counted as one system comprising 11 interoperating ontologies, without splitting its modules.

organizational_logic: Chemical entities and categories form a chemical concept classification through parent-child and other explicit relationships.
inclusion_basis: Beyond term names, it provides explicit ontological classification of molecular entities and broader/narrower structures.
secondary_attributes: F2: Also serves as a chemical dictionary
boundary_note: Lite/Core and formats are not counted separately.
source_title: Chemical Entities of Biological Interest — OBO Foundry

subject_domain: Chemical information, molecular descriptors, algorithms, data provenance
organizational_logic: Expresses chemical data semantics through concepts and relationships such as chemical information entities, descriptors, and generating algorithms.
inclusion_basis: The project and ontology directory explain that it organizes chemical information rather than merely listing chemical entities.
boundary_note: Counted separately from CHMO's experimental methods and ChEBI's chemical entities.

subject_domain: Chemical analysis, sample preparation, separation, synthesis, instruments
organizational_logic: Uses experimental and analytical methods as classes to organize data acquisition, sample processing, synthesis, and related instruments.
inclusion_basis: The OBO entry explicitly includes chemical methods and experimental tools, distinguishing it from compound classification.
boundary_note: Not merged with the chemical entity ontology ChEBI; they organize different objects.

organizational_logic: Organizes entities such as objects, people, events, places, and times through properties, integrating provenance context.
inclusion_basis: Provides a framework of cultural heritage concepts and relationships that can represent event-centered knowledge organization.
boundary_note: CRM is the main record this round; its extension modules are not counted individually.

organizational_logic: Classifies cell types and links them to anatomy and biological processes through relationships such as part_of and capable_of.
inclusion_basis: An explicit cell-type ontology and cross-ontology relationships support structural comparison.
boundary_note: Different release modules are merged.

resource_name: Core Ontology for Biology and Biomedicine
subtype: Shared core ontology for life sciences
organizational_logic: Organizes foundational concepts from other life science ontologies into a smaller common upper-level framework.
inclusion_basis: Official project documentation states that it provides a foundational organizational layer across life science ontologies.
boundary_note: Extensively reuses source ontologies and is listed independently as an application core, but subsequent statistics must distinguish native from imported terms.
source_title: Core Ontology for Biology and Biomedicine

organizational_logic: Expresses concepts, facts, and rules usable for reasoning through formal CycL statements.
inclusion_basis: Contains both concept structures and explicit common-sense rules, providing comparable formalized knowledge organization.
boundary_note: OpenCyc and ResearchCyc are treated as the same knowledge-base lineage; the scope of public availability requires separate later verification.

organizational_logic: Organizes resources using classes such as Resource, Dataset, DataService, and Catalog and relationships involving distributions, services, etc.
inclusion_basis: Officially defines classes and properties for actual catalog objects, adding a data-resource organization scenario.
secondary_attributes: F2: Metadata vocabulary; F4: Graph data applications
boundary_note: Includes the content model; individual catalogs using DCAT are not each counted as KOS.

organizational_logic: Centers on classification of disease concepts, with an asserted is_a hierarchy and cross-ontology equivalence axioms.
inclusion_basis: Disease classification is organized by explicit hierarchies and logical definitions, with an independent maintenance system.
secondary_attributes: F1: Also has a disease classification function
boundary_note: DOID and Mondo have an integration relationship, but independent maintenance objectives and namespaces; they are not treated as different versions.

resource_name: Descriptive Ontology for Linguistic and Cognitive Engineering
organizational_logic: Organizes concepts through foundational categories such as objects, events, and qualities and through formal relationships.
inclusion_basis: Has original formal axiomatization documentation and reusable foundational categories.
boundary_note: Counted as a merged foundational ontology lineage; DUL is a related lightweight derivative whose semantics cannot be treated as identical.
source_title: Descriptive Ontology for Linguistic and Cognitive Engineering (DOLCE)

organizational_logic: Combines the two main classes of evidence types and assertion methods to describe the basis for conclusions and manual or computational assertion methods.
inclusion_basis: Explicit organization of evidence and assertion types distinguishes support derived from experiments and computation.
boundary_note: Its scope differs from PROV-O's process provenance modeling, so it is retained as an independent candidate.

subject_domain: Operations; data types; file formats; topics
organizational_logic: Operation, data, format, and topic concepts organize descriptions of tools and resources through is_a and cross-branch relationships.
inclusion_basis: Provides unified, reusable semantic descriptions of tools, workflows, data, and topics.
boundary_note: The four main branches and versions are counted together.
source_title: EDAM: an ontology of bioinformatics operations, types of data and identifiers, topics and formats

subject_domain: Experimental variables; samples; diseases; genomic research
organizational_logic: Coordinates portions of multiple ontologies with native terms to organize experimental variables and derives classification through OWL reasoning.
inclusion_basis: Has an independent application purpose and logic-based releases; more than a collection of ontology downloads.
boundary_note: Referencing other ontologies does not make EFO a version of them; subsets and formats are merged.

organizational_logic: Starting from physics and materials science concepts, organizes modeling and characterization knowledge through a multilevel conceptual framework.
inclusion_basis: Provides a reusable formal framework for materials science, covering the domain and its foundational layer.
boundary_note: Renaming and different versions belong to the same system; domain extensions are not counted individually.

organizational_logic: Environmental concepts are organized by classes and explicit relationships, linking biological annotations to habitat environments.
inclusion_basis: An independent environmental concept system, distinguishable from SWEET's Earth system framework.
boundary_note: ENVO Lite, Basic, and different formats are not counted repeatedly.

organizational_logic: Financial concepts are defined in modules and connected through relationships such as ownership, issuance, and contracts.
inclusion_basis: Explicit financial concepts, relationships, and OWL logical definitions form an independent system.
boundary_note: The financial modules are counted as one system.

organizational_logic: Explicitly represents knowledge of human body structure through classes of anatomical entities and their relationships.
inclusion_basis: Has an independent human anatomy domain ontology and research literature; not merely a list of anatomical terms.
boundary_note: The original model and OWL representation are treated as the same candidate.
source_title: Foundational Model of Anatomy — NCBO BioPortal

organizational_logic: Classes such as people, organizations, and documents and properties such as knowing and membership form a semantic network.
inclusion_basis: Provides reusable classes and relationships, officially termed a Semantic Web vocabulary or ontology.
boundary_note: Counted as one ontology; its individual terms are not treated as separate candidates.

organizational_logic: Food materials, sources, ingredients, and processing procedures are organized through classes and object relationships.
inclusion_basis: Contains an ontology structure with explicit food roles, materials, and processes, distinct from lists of food names.
secondary_attributes: F2: Has controlled vocabulary and faceted features
boundary_note: Counted primarily as FoodOn; each reused concept is not treated as a new resource.
source_title: FoodOn: A farm to fork ontology

organizational_logic: Uses frames as classes and frame elements as properties to express n-ary knowledge through inheritance and reification/dereification relationships.
inclusion_basis: Has an independent RDFS schema, transforming linguistic frames into a knowledge representation and integration model.
secondary_attributes: F5: Derived from FrameNet/WordNet; F4: Includes instance integration
boundary_note: FrameBase is distinguished from FrameNet: the former is a reconstructed knowledge schema, the latter a lexical frame resource; primarily assigned to F3 this round.

organizational_logic: Spatial features, geometries, and spatial relationships form an RDF/OWL model.
inclusion_basis: The standard includes an explicit domain ontology, enabling comparison of spatial relationship organization.
boundary_note: Only its domain ontology is included; the SPARQL query language and functions are not counted as additional KOS.
source_title: OGC GeoSPARQL — A Geographic Query Language for RDF Data

organizational_logic: Integrates objects and processes and characterizes space-time, properties, relationships, roles, functions, and situations.
inclusion_basis: Provides a unified organization of object-process categories distinct from other upper ontologies.
boundary_note: Basic versions, extended versions, and serializations are not counted independently.

organizational_logic: A small number of classes and relationships express entities, activities, and connections common to enterprises and can be further refined into domain ontologies.
inclusion_basis: An explicit, reusable system of enterprise upper-level classes and relationships.
boundary_note: Core, extensions, and versions are merged; not a single product catalog.

subject_domain: Gene product functions; biological processes; cellular components
organizational_logic: Gene product function concepts form a graph through multiple relationships such as is_a, part_of, and regulates.
inclusion_basis: The structure contains multiple semantically distinct hierarchical and process relationships.
boundary_note: The three main branches, GO-Basic, GO-Plus, and serializations are merged into one system.

organizational_logic: Concepts such as products, services, offers, and businesses and their relationships form transaction descriptions.
inclusion_basis: Has an independent formal semantic vocabulary and specification; not merely a product classification code list.
secondary_attributes: F2: Also officially called a vocabulary
boundary_note: Compatibility with or reuse by Schema.org does not make them the same system; retained as an independent source.

subject_domain: Abnormal human phenotypes; genetic diseases; clinical research
organizational_logic: Abnormal phenotypes are organized through controlled concepts, hierarchies, and logical definitions and can be linked to disease annotations.
inclusion_basis: An independent organizational system for abnormal human phenotypes, distinguishable from disease ontologies.
boundary_note: The HPO ontology and disease annotation data are not counted repeatedly.

organizational_logic: Models concepts and relationships for information entities and related information objects.
inclusion_basis: An independent semantic system for information entities, reusable across various domain ontologies.
boundary_note: Originated from a related OBI branch but is maintained as an independent namespace and ontology; metadata modules are not counted separately.

subject_domain: Industrial facilities, asset lifecycles, engineering processes
organizational_logic: Organizes engineering semantics through classes, relationships, and modeling patterns for industrial assets and lifecycle processes.
inclusion_basis: The official standards project and project description provide an OWL ontology with specific industrial classes and relationships.
boundary_note: The retrieved ISO/FDIS 23726-3 is a final draft and must not be described as formally published; it shares an acronym with Infectious Disease Ontology but is a different resource.

subject_domain: Industrial manufacturing, design, requirements, processes, equipment
organizational_logic: Organizes industrially shared requirements, plans, designs, manufacturing objects, and processes on the basis of BFO.
inclusion_basis: The official release page provides an actual industrial core ontology, rather than merely a directory or consortium.
boundary_note: Includes the IOF Core ontology; the IOF organization and portal are not separate KOS.

resource_name: Legal Knowledge Interchange Format Core Ontology
organizational_logic: A formalized concept system for the legal domain comprising interoperating modules for upper-level, spatiotemporal, mereological, legal, and other concepts.
inclusion_basis: The project published an independent core concept ontology for legal knowledge interoperability.
boundary_note: Only the LKIF Core ontology is counted; the LKIF interchange format itself is not counted additionally. Modules are merged.

subtype: Ontology of scientific domains and research objects
subject_domain: Branches of science, scientific discoveries, phenomena, scientists, instruments
organizational_logic: Links discoveries, phenomena, scientists, and instruments through a hierarchy of scientific branches; includes multiple inheritance, disjoint and equivalent classes, property constraints, and inverse relationships.
inclusion_basis: The original paper and official documentation show that object relationships and axioms go beyond simple disciplinary classification.
secondary_attributes: F1: Disciplinary classification; F4: Scientific knowledge graphs
related_resources: SWEET; FOAF; BFO; DDC; LCC; ANZSRC; SKGO
boundary_note: Counts the shared ModSci framework; unverified modules of the SKGO suite are not split to increase the count. Historical information in the paper is not used to assess the current status of other classifications.

organizational_logic: Integrates concepts, hierarchies, and exact mappings from multiple disease terminologies while retaining provenance.
inclusion_basis: Has an independent integration ontology and source-mapping mechanism, distinct from a single terminology database.
boundary_note: Simple, Base, and other products are merged.

organizational_logic: Concepts have is_a and role relationships, descriptions, and synonyms; OWL provides asserted and inferred versions.
inclusion_basis: Actually publishes an OWL terminology system containing logical relationships, making it valuable for ontology structure comparison.
secondary_attributes: F2: Named and used as a Thesaurus/terminology database
boundary_note: Hybrid boundary case: primary assignment to F3 is this study's grouping based on logical representation, not a denial of its thesaurus nature; flat tables are not treated as a separate system.

organizational_logic: From general assays to specific experimental classes, terms have unique identifiers and logical definitions connecting experiments, equipment, and objectives.
inclusion_basis: Covers research processes and their participating entities, with explicit terms and logical relationships.
boundary_note: Core, Base, and serializations are merged.

organizational_logic: Organizes permissions and restrictions around Policy, Permission, Prohibition, Duty, Party, Asset, Action, and Constraint.
inclusion_basis: The official information model provides rights-policy classes and relationships with specific domain semantics.
boundary_note: Only ODRL's content ontology is counted; rule engines or general-purpose representation languages are not treated as another KOS.

organizational_logic: Organizations, suborganizations, posts, memberships, roles, locations, and organizational changes are interconnected.
inclusion_basis: Provides an organizational structure relationship model reusable across institutions.
boundary_note: The Registered Organization extension is not counted again.

organizational_logic: Temporal entities, instants, intervals, and temporal relationships such as precedence and inclusion; temporal positions and durations.
inclusion_basis: Has explicit temporal concepts and ordering relationships; not the OWL language itself.
boundary_note: OWL-Time is a content ontology, distinct from OWL as a representation language.

organizational_logic: Organizes phenotypic qualities such as color and size, combinable with anatomy or biological process concepts.
inclusion_basis: Has a reusable concept system for qualities, used in logical definitions of more complex phenotypes.
boundary_note: Different from HPO: PATO focuses on qualities, while HPO focuses on abnormal human phenotypes.
source_title: Phenotype And Trait Ontology — OBO Foundry

organizational_logic: Hierarchically organizes collections of interacting organisms, populations, and multispecies communities and describes their qualities, processes, and membership relationships.
inclusion_basis: The project's source ontology explicitly provides is_a, relationships, and logical intersections, adding organization at the level of ecological collections.
boundary_note: Verified against publicly available project definitions; some concepts have notes on incomplete axioms, so completeness of all relationships is not claimed.
source_title: Population and Community Ontology — source definitions

subject_domain: Plant anatomy; morphology; growth and development
organizational_logic: Organizes plant structure and development concepts into an ontology for linking genomic annotations.
inclusion_basis: A shared concept system for plant structure, growth, and development, independent of trait ontologies.
boundary_note: Anatomy and development branches belong to the same PO; OWL/OBO are not counted separately.

organizational_logic: Organizes evolutionarily related proteins, specific gene products, and protein-containing complexes, with both species-specific and species-neutral classes.
inclusion_basis: Explicitly distinguishes types of protein-related entities and formally defines their relationships.
boundary_note: Asserted/inferred releases are not counted separately; the prefix PR and abbreviation PRO refer to the same system.

organizational_logic: Entities, activities, and agents form the framework, connected by generation, usage, derivation, and responsibility relationships.
inclusion_basis: Has independent classes, properties, and constraints for organizing provenance information across domains.
boundary_note: Different representation formats in the PROV family are merged; only ontology content is counted.

organizational_logic: Links quantity values, quantity kinds, units, dimensions, and data types to express measurement structure and compatibility.
inclusion_basis: Has a complete measurement concept model and associated vocabularies, suitable for comparing cross-domain relationship organization.
secondary_attributes: F2: Includes vocabularies for units, etc.
related_resources: QUDT vocabularies for units, quantity kinds, and dimensions
boundary_note: Modules and vocabularies are counted as one system.

organizational_logic: Defines reusable relationship types and axioms, including part_of and develops_from.
inclusion_basis: Its objects are explicit semantic relationships and their constraints, enabling unified relationship meanings across multiple domain ontologies.
boundary_note: Unlike RDF/OWL, RO defines relationship content with domain/upper-level semantics and is not a representation language; subsets are not counted separately.

subtype: Internet of Things domain ontology suite
subject_domain: Internet of Things; energy; buildings; industry; etc.
organizational_logic: Core concepts, reference patterns, and vertical domain extensions jointly organize devices, functions, and related applications.
inclusion_basis: A shared semantic model for smart applications across industries, with a core ontology and explicit extension structure.
boundary_note: Extensions of the SAREF family are counted together.

organizational_logic: Organizes model semantics through controlled relational vocabularies for reaction participant roles, quantitative parameters, mathematical expressions, modeling frameworks, etc.
inclusion_basis: The official repository explicitly provides controlled, interrelated terms for computational systems biology.
boundary_note: SBO's multiple orthogonal branches are merged into one entry; model databases using it are not counted.

organizational_logic: Type hierarchies and properties jointly describe Web entities, allowing a type to have multiple parent types.
inclusion_basis: Forms a reusable, cross-domain semantic model through explicit types and properties.
secondary_attributes: F2: Also officially called a vocabulary
boundary_note: Positioned as a lightweight ontology; the official website states that it is not a general-purpose philosophical ontology.

subject_domain: Biomedicine, scientific data, information, and processes
organizational_logic: Connects more specific biomedical concepts through foundational classes and relationships for objects, processes, attributes, quantities, and information.
inclusion_basis: The original paper describes foundational types and semantic relationships usable for scientific knowledge discovery.
boundary_note: General-purpose foundational elements and domain specializations form one system and are not counted by branch.
source_title: The Semanticscience Integrated Ontology (SIO) for biomedical research and knowledge discovery

organizational_logic: Uses Community, Container, Forum, Item, Post, account, and role classes to express containment, creation, reply, and other relationships; Forum is a subclass of Container.
inclusion_basis: The official specification shows concrete class hierarchies and relationships between content and users.
boundary_note: Core, Types, and Services modules are merged; the 2007 specification uses User, while newer project specifications use UserAccount. This submission document is not described as a W3C Recommendation.

organizational_logic: Concepts are organized through an is_a polyhierarchy and defining attributes; description logic axioms support inferred classification.
inclusion_basis: Formal definitions explicitly use description logic and OWL axioms, supporting primary placement among ontologies rather than treating it as a terminology database solely by its name.
boundary_note: Codes are identifiers; parent-child relationships are not inferred from numeric prefixes. Language and national extensions are not counted separately.
source_title: High Level Logical Model of SNOMED CT

organizational_logic: Terms and relationships describe sequence features and attributes, distinguishing features of biological entities, experimental materials, and experimental results.
inclusion_basis: An independent system of concepts and relationships for sequence features.
boundary_note: SOFA is a subset and is not counted separately.
source_title: Sequence types and features ontology — OBO Foundry

subject_domain: Scholarly publishing, citations, document structure, publishing workflows
organizational_logic: A set of cooperating OWL 2 ontologies describes publication types, citations, document components, roles, and publishing workflows.
inclusion_basis: The project and original paper provide a complete system of concepts and relationships for publishing activities.
secondary_attributes: F2: Bibliographic vocabularies; F4: Citation graphs
related_resources: FaBiO; CiTO; BiRO; C4O; DoCO; PSO; PRO (publishing roles); PWO; FOAF; PROV-O
boundary_note: Counted as one ontology family, without inflating the total by counting individual modules; publishing-role PRO differs from Protein Ontology.

resource_name: Semantic Sensor Network Ontology / Sensor, Observation, Sample, and Actuator
organizational_logic: Systems, sensors, observation activities, observed properties, and results are connected; SOSA is the lightweight core.
inclusion_basis: Shared observation and sampling semantics across environmental, industrial, and Internet of Things domains.
boundary_note: SOSA is the core of SSN and is counted together with it; different versions are not counted independently.

resource_name: Semantic Web for Earth and Environmental Terminology
